questions.topic: PrepLadder · 34.Chicken Pox, Small Pox and Diphtheria
questions.stem: A 35-year-old man presents with a fever and a rash that started as small, red spots on his trunk and has now progressed to fluid-filled blisters over the past 3 days. He mentions that he recently returned from a business trip where he attended a conference with participants from various countries. What is the most likely period during which he could have contracted chickenpox?
